name: c16_abmil_v1
task: slide-level metastasis detection (any tumor vs normal)

split.test: official CAMELYON16 evaluation set (not a carve-out)

seal_policy.enforced_by: scripts/bench/train_abmil.py --official-test (refuses without a registered protocol; refuses a second run)
seal_policy.statement: No model, hyperparameter choice, or aggregation may be informed by test slides. Test embeddings are computed blind and scored once.
